items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: Milton Buckner would call -- he was the man in charge and the leader of the group

ctx.x: Milton Buckner, Andre Preppy Presciano on piano, Roland le Bourgeois on bass, Panama Francis on drums, Wallace Davenport on trumpet, Buster Cooper on trombone. Earle Warren on saxophone, ie Chamblee Eddy Chorney on saxophone and yours truly, Arnette Cobb.
I liked the idea of having two tenor players
